questions_answered.q: 4. What must user do outside Codex?
questions_answered.a: Rotate SSH, SECRET_KEY, SMTP password. Update production env vars. Review server logs.

questions_answered.q: 5. Is project safer for local development?
questions_answered.a: YES — requirements.txt, README setup docs, .gitignore protection, safe deploy templates all reduce risk for future developers.
REALWORLD-2-P3 (test repair + Django version alignment) if user wants to fix test pass rate; or CONTEXT-SPACE-P8 for usability hardening; or user review.
